rules.label: Medical Indigent Threshold #1 (301%-500% FPL, bill >25% income)
rules.quote: A patient whose family income is between 301% and 500% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL). Patient's single incident medical bills are greater than 25% of yearly gross household income. Patient will be billed the lesser of 5% of gross annual family income or 50% of the amounts generally billed (AGB).

rules.label: Medical Indigent Threshold #2 (>500% FPL, bill >25% income)
rules.quote: A patient whose family income is greater than 500% of the FPL. Patient's single incident Medical bills are greater than 25% of yearly gross household income. Patient will be billed the lesser of 10% of gross annual family income or 50% of the AGB.

application.quote: 45 days from the date of primary insurance payment

eca_not_before.quote: No account will be forwarded to collections for forty-five (45) days after financial assistance application has been requested.

payment_plan.quote: Accounts must be paid in full within 24 months from date of service. Payments plans must be a minimum of $25.00 per month

notes: Policy requires patients to obtain health insurance if financial capacity allows, apply for Colorado Medicaid, and apply for Hospital Discounted Care (HDC) or provide written documentation why steps cannot be achieved prior to consideration for financial assistance.
Patients must be overqualified for HDC based on HDC Screening or have an HDC ineligible determination letter, OR be financially indigent, medically indigent, or meet presumptive eligibility.

Assets considered: bank account balances, cash reserves, retirement/IRA balances showing withdrawals, other easily accessible financial resources. Assets NOT considered: marketable assets listed for sale, real estate listed for sale, tangible assets (vehicles, household goods), non-liquid/non-convertible resources.
Assistance approved retroactively covers 6 months from date of approval and remains valid for 1 year from first date of service applied to. Patient must reapply to maintain assistance.

Reapplication allowed if: 6 months passed since denial (new application cannot apply to service dates associated with previous denial); significant financial changes since most recent approval/denial; approved assistance is set to expire.

AGB determined using 'look-back' method per IRS/Treasury 501 rule section 4(b)(2): data based on claims allowed by Medicaid in combination with Medicare fee-for-service and all private health insurers paying claims to hospital during prior 12-month period. AGB percentage multiplied by gross charges for Emergency Care and Medically Necessary Care. Discount applies to patient's personal responsibility amount after all deductions, discounts, and insurance reimbursements.
Hardship application requires patient to declare all assets including investments, property of significant value, stocks, bonds, settlements received, and all other sources of assets or income.

Collection policy: accounts with approved sliding fee discount must be paid per normal terms or sent to collections. Accounts subject to collections after 6 months of nonpayment or underpayment. Minimum one contact attempt prior to forwarding to collections.
Policy applies only to Memorial Regional Health. Outside vendors not covered.
Cosmetic procedures excluded from eligible services.
For households >8 persons, add $5,380 for each additional person to FPL guidelines.
Financial Counselors notify patient in writing within 30 days of receipt of FAA.
Sliding fee schedule advertised through posted signage, social media, website, and verbally at registration to self-pay patients.

application.quote: 45 days from the date of primary insurance payment, or 45 days from Medicaid denial

payment_plan.quote: Accounts must be paid in full within 24 months from date of service 2. Payments plans must be a minimum of $25.00 per month

notes: Eligible Services include emergency medical services, services for conditions that if not promptly treated would lead to adverse health status change, non-elective services in response to life-threatening circumstances in a non-emergency room setting, elective services excluding cosmetic procedures, and primary care services.

Assets considered in review: bank account balances, cash reserves, retirement/IRA balances showing withdrawals, other easily accessible financial resources. Assets not considered: marketable assets currently listed for sale, real estate property listed for sale, tangible assets (vehicles, household goods), non-liquid, non-convertible resources.

To determine AGB, MRH uses the look-back method based on claims allowed by Medicaid in combination with Medicare fee for service and all private health insurers that pay claims to the hospital during the prior 12-month period. The AGB percentage is multiplied by gross charges for Emergency Care and Medically Necessary Care to determine AGB.

Financial Assistance will be approved or denied based on the completed FAA and other provisions of this policy. If approved, patient accounts will be adjusted based on a sliding scale. If denied, appeals will be considered by providing additional or clarifying information. Assistance will retroactively cover six months from the date of approval and remain valid for one year from the first date of service applied to. Patients may reapply if six months have passed since denial, significant financial changes occurred, or approved assistance is set to expire.

No account will be forwarded to collections for forty-five days after financial assistance application has been requested. A minimum of one contact attempt will be made prior to forwarding an account to collections.
